contradicting.claim: ga's governance/demerzel submodule pins 25346b7 (2026-04-03), 791 commits behind Demerzel master; its last bump was 7647f9b5 on 2026-04-04. The 'current submodules' conjunct is false. Root cause: ga's submodule-auto-update.yml fails on every run. On large updates it runs `git log --oneline "$CURRENT..$LATEST" | head -15` under `-o pipefail`; head closes the pipe and git log dies of SIGPIPE (exit 141) after the branch push but before `gh pr create`. Same-day re-runs then fail non-fast-forward on the dated branch. Result: 52 orphan chore/update-demerzel-* branches on ga and zero update PRs ever opened. Demerzel's submodule-notify did raise ga issue #582 (2026-08-05, 736 behind), which is still open.
